tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('api/server.go')
content = path.read_text()
old = 'func (s *Server) Start() {}\\n\\nfunc (s *Server) internalRun() {}\\n'
new = 'func (s *Server) Start() {}\\n\\nfunc InitServer() *Server {\\n\\treturn &Server{}\\n}\\n\\nfunc (s *Server) internalRun() {}\\n'
if content.count(old) "'!= 1:
    raise SystemExit('"'expected insertion point exactly once in api/server.go')
updated = content.replace(old, new, 1)
stat = path.stat()
mtime_ns = max(time.time_ns(), stat.st_mtime_ns + 1_000_000)
fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.server.go.', dir=path.parent)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as temp_file:
        temp_file.write(updated)
        temp_file.flush()
        os.fchmod(temp_file.fileno(), stat.st_mode)
        os.utime(temp_name, ns=(stat.st_atime_ns, mtime_ns))
        os.fsync(temp_file.fileno())
    os.replace(temp_name, path)
    dir_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dir_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(dir_fd)
except BaseException:
    try:
        os.unlink(temp_name)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    raise
PY
cat api/server.go"
